TRUSTED SERVICE SINCE 1981
ABOUT

We started with three trucks, a rented two-car garage shop area, and an office in one of our founder’s homes. We didn’t have truck radios or cell phones, so we relied on pay phones and a supply of dimes. From a small-repair plumbing company to a full-service plumbing company, we have grown to include new construction and commercial construction services as well as timely repairs and full warranties. But since the beginning, we have focused on seriously good service, knowledgeable employees, and supporting our customers by providing knowledge, support, and quick assistance no matter the plumbing problem. We believe in the integrity of our company and we love to supply solutions to even the most difficult plumbing problems.

Fixing your problems before they become problems. REPAIR SERVICE

SERVICES
New Construction

Planning and building a house is stressful enough, so let us worry about your plumbing needs. When Brand Plumbing helps you with your new construction, you can ensure that your products will be installed right the first time.

SEWERS
SEPTIC TANKS
REPIPING
BACKFLOW TESTING
WATER CONDITIONING
YARD SPRINKLER SYSTEMS
RADIANT FLOOR HEAT
Radiant Floor Heat

Radiant floor heat is the best option in some applications to heat your home while saving money. With radiant floor heat, your entire floor becomes a heater — which helps maintain a constant comfortable temperature.

Backflow Testing

Backflow preventers are devices that protect dangerous contaminants from entering the public water supply. An annual test of your backflow preventer is required by the City of Wichita. Our licensed backflow testers can perform all required tests and maintenance on your backflow devices to make sure that they are functioning properly.

Water Conditioning

Water quality varies greatly within the local area. Let us take a sample and have your water tested, which is the only way to ensure your system is providing the correct amount of conditioning. We can implement water softeners, reverse osmosis systems, and whole-house filters depending on your test results and your needs.

Yard Sprinkler Systems

We can help you get your yard back to beautiful again by designing and installing sprinkler systems.

HVAC

If you need HVAC support or installation, contact our partners at Cook’s to get set up.

Replacement of Water and Sewer Systems

Whether you are experiencing age-related plumbing problems or breakages, or whether a home remodel demands an update, we can help you replace and service your water and sewer systems.

Commercial Construction

We want to help you protect your business by providing expertly installed plumbing systems. We understand that all commercial construction projects have different plumbing needs, and our experts can provide complete plumbing solutions for all types of commercial applications.

REPAIRS & REPIPING
Fixing your problems before they become problems.

Whether you need same-day help or long-term assistance, our team is equipped with the tools necessary to identify and fix your problems. We can offer same-day plumbing solutions — our vans are fully stocked and our team is ready to repair faucets, disposals, toilets, sinks, and water heaters (natural gas, electric, and propane). And if we don’t have the part you need, we’ll source it locally from one of our trusted partners if possible.

Residential Repairs

No matter your residential repair needs, we can get you back up and running in no time. We offer the following repair services:

LOCATE HARD-TO-FIND PARTS
PROVIDE SPECIALTY FIXTURES
PROVIDE WATER SUPPLY LINE REPAIRS
PROVIDE SEWAGE AND DRAIN LINE REPAIRS
PROVIDE SLOW DRAIN REPAIRS

WARRANTY & PRODUCTS
Trusted Products

Brand Plumbing only uses trusted products that we have researched thoroughly. The following is a list of suppliers with some of the best customer approval rates in the industry, and these are some of the products that we regularly recommend and install.

DELTA FAUCETS AND CUSTOM DESIGNED SHOWER APPLICATIONS
AKER FIBERGLASS TUBS/SHOWERS
TOTO TOILETS AND LAVATORIES
PEARL WHIRLPOOL TUBS AND SOAKER TUBS
GROHE FAUCETS AND CUSTOM DESIGNED SHOWER APPLICATIONS
TRAJET WHIRLPOOL TUBS AND SOAKER TUBS
ZOELLER SUMP PUMPS AND SEWAGE EJECTOR PUMPS
UPONOR WATER PIPING MATERIALS
BRADFORD WHITE WATER HEATERS
KOHLER FAUCETS, SINKS, TOILETS, LAVATORIES
SWANSTONE KITCHEN SINKS
Warranty

Brand Plumbing wants to support you, even after the job is done. We offer full warranty of all new products that we provide, including labor charges for one full year. No more waiting around. No more searching for new products. Just call our office as soon as there’s a problem, and we’ll contact the manufacturer, obtain all replacements, and ensure that all warranties are honored.

While we can install plumbing fixtures that you provide, we cannot offer warranty on products that we do not supply. When you purchase products online, the quality of the product will be reduced. Many fixtures might seem okay, but they don’t hold up to industry standards. Some are made using plastics that can decompose causing problems later on, whereas a professional-grade fixture has the added value of lasting longer.

Fixing your problems before they become problems. REPAIR SERVICE
